title: feat(ui): kanban board draws only the declared lanes, in their order
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoA3RUhHxoGDcojjSZo3nLDR)_

Fixes #28211
Refs #28018

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：看板视图现在按 `kanban.lanes` 只画作者列出的泳道、按作者的顺序；两条生成看板的路径（列表视图与 object-view 元素）都把它映射到看板已有的 `columns` 键上。
- 为什么改：键已在 spec 里声明，但 Console 不读它，HotCRM 任务看板仍画一条永远为空的「已完成」泳道，作者也排不了泳道顺序。
- 风险与回滚：没写 `lanes` 的看板完全不变；未列出取值的记录落进「未分类」泳道，不会被藏起来。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/utils/kanban-declared-lanes.ts`（映射规则），`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` 的 `case 'kanban'`，`ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` 的 `case 'kanban'`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.declaredLanes-28211.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例全绿（只画列出的泳道、顺序对、未列出的进「未分类」）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/core`**: new `kanbanDeclaredLanes(lanes, options)`. It turns a list view's `kanban.lanes` into the `object-kanban` node's `columns`, in the author's order. Each lane is titled with its option's label, or with the value itself while the definition is still loading. A lane whose option has `kind: 'lost'` gets `collapsed: true`, keeping the #26612 behaviour. No `lanes` returns `undefined`.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-list`** (`ListView`, `case 'kanban'`) and **`@object-ui/plugin-view`** (`ObjectView#generateViewSchema`, `case 'kanban'`): both producers of the node read `kanban.lanes` by name and emit `columns` only when lanes are declared. `generateViewSchema` now also depends on `objectSchema`, so the titles follow the definition once it lands.
- **`ObjectKanban.tsx` is unchanged.** Its explicit-columns branch already draws `columns` in order and localizes each title. A record whose value matches no lane already lands in `Uncategorized`, both when loaded rows are bucketed and when lanes page on their own: `pagedLaneIdsKey` reads declared columns first, and the uncolumned lane's query is "not in the listed ids".
- **`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`**: only the `kanban` row changes. Its note moves `lanes` from planned to live and cites the readers by symbol.
- Root changeset `.changeset/28211-kanban-declared-lanes.md`, with every package at `patch`.

Why the producers and not `ObjectKanban`: the node's face, `ComponentPropsMap['object-kanban']`, declares no `lanes`, and both producers forward only named block keys. Mapping onto the existing `columns` key needs no spec edit. The seat's claim amendment records this surface.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/kanban-declared-lanes-28211.test.ts` (4 cases): order and labels, no lanes, author order over lifecycle order with lost collapsed, value title before options load.
- New `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.declaredLanes-28211.test.tsx` (3 cases): the real board draws only the listed lanes in order, an unlisted value lands in `Uncategorized`, and a listed lost lane starts collapsed.
- New `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.kanbanDeclaredLanes-28211.test.tsx` and `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.kanbanDeclaredLanes-28211.test.tsx` (2 cases each): the generated node carries the declared `columns`, and a control shows that no `lanes` means no `columns`.
- Ablation: the `columns` spread was deleted with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in each producer, and restore was proven by blob hash. Predicted and observed: the `columns` case of that producer's test goes red (`1 failed | 1 passed`) and its control stays green.

## Acceptance notes

- S2 (the `checkKanbanLanes` docblock line) does not ride. That module is `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts`, outside the liveness file. The `KanbanConfigSchema.lanes` TSDoc in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` still says it "Lands ahead of its reader", which is now false. Both are spec-source edits that the seat files as a `domain:spec` follow-up after merge.
- In `ListView.tsx`, one hunk sits outside `case 'kanban'`: the `@object-ui/core` import line gains `kanbanDeclaredLanes`. That matters for the serial overlap with seat 4's #25918 in the same file. When this branch was cut, `origin/main` had no change to that file.
- The renderer does not dedupe or filter `lanes`. Membership and repeats are judged at authoring (`list-view-kanban-lane-unknown` / `-repeated` in `@objectstack/lint`).
- ui `AGENTS.md` #2 (docs-driven) is not covered: no README or `content/docs/frontend/` page is touched, because both are outside the claimed surface. The spec key's own docs already describe the behaviour.

Head `8f4d9c61`, base `6285203d`.
